name: jira-data-center
label: Jira Data Center
description: Issue tracking and project management for Jira Data Center and Server

instanceUrl.label: Instance URL
instanceUrl.description: The address of your Jira Data Center, such as jira.yourcompany.com. It must use https on the standard port, without a path such as /jira.

personalAccessToken.label: Personal Access Token
personalAccessToken.description: Your Jira Data Center Personal Access Token (PAT)

create_issue.label: Create Issue
create_issue.description: Creates an issue from a project, issue type, summary and optional fields.

projectIdOrKey.label: Project
projectIdOrKey.description: The project key, such as PROJ.

issueTypeId.label: Issue Type
issueTypeId.description: The numeric issue type ID, such as 10002.

fields.label: Other Fields
fields.description: JSON object of other field IDs to values, e.g. {"priority": "2", "labels": ["web"], "customfield_10100": 5}. Options, versions and components take their ID, users and groups their name. Field IDs come from the fields Jira shows for the project and issue type.

update_issue.label: Update Issue
update_issue.description: Moves an issue to a new status and updates only the given fields.

issueIdOrKey.label: Issue
issueIdOrKey.description: The issue key (e.g. PROJ-123) or numeric issue ID. Find it with Search Issues.

statusId.label: Status
statusId.description: The ID of the transition to the new status. Leave it empty to keep the status.

fields.label: Other Fields
fields.description: JSON object of other field IDs to values, e.g. {"priority": "2", "labels": ["web"], "customfield_10100": 5}. Options, versions and components take their ID, users and groups their name. Field IDs come from the fields Jira lets you edit on the issue.

update_issue.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.statusId) return request;
return { ...request, method: 'POST', url: '/issue/' + encodeURIComponent(inputs.issueIdOrKey) + '/transitions', body: { transition: { id: inputs.statusId } } };

add_issue_comment.label: Add Comment
add_issue_comment.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

projectIdOrKey.label: Project
projectIdOrKey.description: Narrows the issues to choose from. It is not sent.

issueIdOrKey.label: Issue
issueIdOrKey.description: The issue key (e.g. PROJ-123) or numeric issue ID. Find it with Search Issues.

search_issues.label: Search Issues
search_issues.description: Finds issues that match a JQL query, with all their fields.

jql.label: JQL
jql.description: Put text and dates in single quotes.

maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.description: Most issues to return, up to 100.

get_issue.label: Get Issue
get_issue.description: Gets an issue's fields and details.

projectIdOrKey.label: Project
projectIdOrKey.description: Narrows the issues to choose from. It is not sent.

issueIdOrKey.label: Issue
issueIdOrKey.description: The issue key (e.g. PROJ-123) or numeric issue ID. Find it with Search Issues.

expand.label: Extra Data
expand.description: More sections to include in the output. A JSON list of: renderedFields, names, schema, transitions, editmeta, changelog.

mapNames.label: Map Field Names
mapNames.description: Key fields by their name instead of their ID.

mapTransitions.label: Map Transition Names
mapTransitions.description: Adds the issue's transitions, keyed by name.
